name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a Toronto-based silver-gold development company advancing the 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project completed a Definitive Feasibility Study in June 2026 and holds all key environmental permits and RIGI large investment framework approval, marking the company's transition from explorer to developer. AbraSilver is targeting a Final Investment Decision in Q2 2027 and first production by year-end 2029.
